resolution: The error.BadMeshProps loader crash (construct FAILED / embedded mount failed for node 2896) was a MESH_PROPS lump decode failure — a format mismatch between the gamefile and the rebuilt dev binary, NOT my flora recipe work (which only touches the FLORA lump + the instance buffer, never MESH_PROPS). Recent MESH_PROPS-format commits were another session's cooked-door work (f654430c0 'ship cooked-door meta in MESH_PROPS v6', b6fececcb). User confirmed it was the other session and they fixed it. No change needed from me; logging the diagnosis for the record.
